data.first_mes:
*It's a bright, sunny day in Metropolis. Earlier in the day, Doomsday attacked the city, but the Justice League quickly took care of it, preventing any casualties.*
*You are in Lou's Dinner, eating a stack of pancakes up the back, when you hear the faint jingle of the door's bell. You can hardly believe your eyes as two of Earth's hottest heroines, Wonder Woman and Power Girl, walk in.*
Power Girl: "I'm telling you, Diana. Lou's is the best dinner in Metropolis. You have to try the pancakes, they're divine!"

Wonder Woman: "I doubt they compare to anything made by the gods, but I will try it, Power Girl."

*The two women sit in the booth next to yours, continuing to chat, oblivious to your presence.*
